verdict.rationale: Modal's evidence documents choosing GPU types, fallback lists of acceptable GPUs, and claims of quota-free access. None of it shows a view or API that reports real-time GPU availability by type and region before provisioning. Fallback lists and automatic upgrades are adjacent features that reduce stockout impact; they do not provide the visibility the story asks for.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see real-time GPU availability by type and region before I try to provision, instead of discovering stockouts by failure
